title: 番外假如朔衡变成反派4番外假如朔衡变成反派3
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
朔衡收到祭祀邀请函的第二天，夏裕岚就用传音令牌找到他。
“听说，凤凰族邀请朔兄参与祭祀？”
传音令牌中，夏裕岚的声音透着浓浓的笑意和意味深长，“朔兄身怀奇火，想得到神树的青睐并不困难，
所以…要不要跟我合作一次？”
朔衡不动声色的问道：“合作什么？”
“进入神树空间，除了朔兄本身所得到的传承之外，其余一切对你没用的材料，都可以交给我们百宝商行代为出售。
凤凰族中的宝物千百年来不见得能流出一件，放在外面可都是被人人争抢的宝贝，绝对能卖出让朔兄满意的价格。”
朔衡的手指有节奏的落在太师椅的扶手上，目光幽深，看着窗外天幕逐渐阴沉下来…
那是风雨欲来的征兆。
“再议吧。”
朔衡单方面切断通讯，随手把传音令牌收起来。
随后，他转手拿出那枚在轩辕秘境人祖前辈手中得到的玉碟。
把玉碟佩戴在身上，能加快领悟法则之力，是个不可多得的宝物。
但现在这宝物被朔衡拿在手里，竟觉得有些烫手。
他眯起眼睛，最终还是默默把玉碟贴身放好。
多说无益。唯有实力强大，才能决定自己想要的一切。
次日清晨，朔衡告别了芜仙，独自踏上前往朝天城的道路。
凤凰族的凰天凝和族中长老在这里等他，一同启程返回族地。
广场上，凰天凝看到朔衡的身影，面带笑意的迎上去：“朔道友，你来了。
这位是我族的七长老，叫他沐长老即可。

沐长老，这位就是苍澜仙宫太初峰的朔衡。”
朔衡拱手行礼：“见过沐长老。”
“免礼，免礼……朔衡小友在比武大会中的出色表现。虽然本座未曾有幸亲眼得见，但整个天怒界域可是传的沸沸扬扬。”
沐长老伸手扶起朔衡的手臂。
他面容和蔼，看起来是个很好相处的老者，“若是凤凰族年轻一辈的青年才俊皆如小友这般，那老夫便是做梦都要笑醒了。”
“沐长老谬赞了。”
朔衡应了一声，面上只维持着礼貌的浅笑，没有半分被当面夸奖的骄矜。
经历过那件事后，他的情绪隐藏更深了。
即便是沐长老这样活了数十个纪元的强者，也很难看清朔衡心里到底在想什么。
他盯着眼前的青年瞧了几眼，只觉得…
content_en:
The day after Shuoheng received the invitation letter for the sacrifice, Xia Yulan used the sound transmission token to find him.
"I heard that the Phoenix Clan invited Brother Shuo to participate in the sacrifice?"
In the sound transmission token, Xia Yulan's voice was full of smile and meaningful, "Brother Shuo has a strange fire, it is not difficult to win the favor of the sacred tree.
So...do you want to work with me once? "
Shuo Heng asked calmly: "What cooperation?"
"When you enter the Sacred Tree Space, apart from the inheritance that Brother Shuo himself has received, all other materials that are of no use to you can be handed over to our Baibao Trading Company to sell them on your behalf.
It is rare for a treasure among the Phoenix clan to be released in thousands of years. If it is placed outside, it will be a treasure that everyone is fighting for. It can definitely be sold at a price that satisfies Brother Shuo. "
Shuo Heng's fingers fell rhythmically on the armrests of the Grand Master's chair. His eyes were deep as he watched the sky outside the window gradually darken...
That was a sign that storm was coming.
"Let's discuss it later."
Shuo Heng unilaterally cut off the communication and put away the sound transmission token.
Then, he turned around and took out the jade plate he had obtained from the senior ancestor of Xuanyuan Secret Realm.
Wearing a jade plate on your body can speed up your understanding of the power of the law. It is a rare treasure.
But now that Shuo Heng was holding this treasure in his hand, it actually felt a little hot.
He narrowed his eyes and finally silently placed the jade dish close to his body.
There is no use in talking more. Only with great strength can you decide what you want.
Early the next morning, Shuo Heng said goodbye to Wuxian and embarked on the road to Chaotian City alone.
Huang Tianning and the elders of the Phoenix clan were waiting for him here, and they set off together to return to the clan.
In the square, Huang Tianning saw Shuo Heng's figure and greeted him with a smile: "Fellow Daoist Shuo, you are here.
This is the seventh elder of our clan, just call him Elder Mu.
Elder Mu, this is Shuo Heng from Taichu Peak of Canglan Immortal Palace. "
Shuo Heng raised his hands and saluted: "I have met Elder Mu."
"No courtesy, no courtesy... little friend Shuo Heng's outstanding performance in the martial arts competition. Although I have never been lucky enough to see it with my own eyes, it is widely spread throughout the Skywrath Realm."
Elder Mu stretched out his hand to support Shuo Heng's arm.
He has a kind face and seems to be an old man who is easy to get along with. "If the young talents of the younger generation of the Phoenix clan are like this little friend, then I will laugh out of my dreams."
"Elder Mu is so complimentary."
Shuo Heng responded, with only a polite smile on his face, not the slightest bit arrogant about being praised in person.
After experiencing that incident, his emotions were hidden deeper.
Even for a strong man like Elder Mu who has lived for dozens of epochs, it is difficult to see clearly what Shuo Heng is thinking.
He stared at the young man in front of him for a few times and felt...
